title: SpaceX, Anthropic plan to share wealth with the public amid concern AI could trigger job losses
hook_text: SpaceX and Anthropic plan wealth sharing
script:
SpaceX and Anthropic plan to share wealth with the public.
The initiative comes amid growing concern that AI could trigger job losses.
Dario Amodei leads Anthropic as chief executive officer.
Elon Musk serves as the chief executive officer of SpaceX.
Both SpaceX and Anthropic are exploring models to distribute equity or financial returns directly to citizens.
This strategy aims to offset economic inequality driven by rapid automation.
Such proposals mark a major shift in how private technology firms address labor displacement.
Would you trust tech firms to offset automation drops?
